verdict.rationale: Convex has separate dev/production deployments (npx convex dev pushes to dev deployment, not prod) and the official MCP server explicitly blocks access to production deployments by default as a safety measure to prevent accidental modifications to production data, directly enabling sandboxed testing for AI agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of this safety boundary actually holding in practice, and no explicit mention of a dedicated 'staging' environment distinct from dev/prod.
